## Professional Summary

Nasr Eddine Yakhou (Nas) is a Software Engineer specializing in AI/LLM integration, eCommerce development, and SEO optimization. He builds web applications that solve real business problems—balancing speed with scalability based on project requirements.

## Core Expertise

### AI/LLM Integration
- Building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
- Custom AI assistants using OpenRouter, OpenAI, and Anthropic
- Vector embeddings and semantic search with Qdrant
- Intelligent web scraping and data extraction with Playwright
- Automated content analysis and structured data extraction

### eCommerce Development
- Architecting scalable platforms
- Payment integration (Stripe, PayPal)
- Admin dashboards with analytics
- Subscription management
- Automated license delivery systems

### SEO Optimization
- Technical SEO strategies (SSR, semantic HTML, schema markup)
- Core Web Vitals optimization (60s to 95+ page speed scores)
- 40%+ organic traffic increases through comprehensive strategies

Node.js, Fastify, tRPC, Go, gRPC, Python, Drizzle ORM, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, MongoDB, BullMQ

## Work Experience

Building and enhancing enterprise software solutions and ERPs with focus on accounting systems and AI integration using React, Python, PostgreSQL, and OpenAI/Anthropic LLMs.

### VexLogic Ltd (Apr 2025 - Nov 2025)
**Role**: AI/LLM Specialist & Lead Developer
Built production-ready AI solutions including RAG systems, custom AI assistants, and intelligent automation tools using OpenRouter, OpenAI, and Qdrant.

### Tech4Fab (Jun 2024 - Apr 2025)
**Role**: Full Stack Developer
Developed a widget builder platform with drag-and-drop functionality for creating custom dashboards with real-time data visualization.

### Techivation Ltd (Sep 2021 - Dec 2023)
**Role**: IT Specialist & Lead Developer
Led development of high-performance eCommerce platform. Drove 40%+ increase in organic traffic and improved page speed from 60s to 95+. Led team of 3 developers.

### SoliderSound Ltd (Apr 2023 - Dec 2023)
**Role**: Lead Developer
Built complete eCommerce solution achieving first-page rankings for key product terms. Reduced page load time by 50%. Led team of 2 developers.

### BRENCO Engineering & Consulting (Aug 2021 - Feb 2022)
**Role**: Full Stack Developer
First full-time developer role. Built monitoring systems, maintained IoT APIs, and developed custom websites for startups.

## Projects

### Templates
- [Website Template](https://nascodes.dev/projects/website-template): Next.js 16 starter with 56 UI components, SEO tooling, and Docker deployment. Cut project setup from weeks to hours.
- [App Template](https://nascodes.dev/projects/app-template): Full-stack monorepo starter (Hono + React + PostgreSQL) with end-to-end type safety via oRPC and Turborepo.
- [Jinja Template Renderer](https://nascodes.dev/projects/jinja-template-renderer): Standalone Jinja2 previewer with AST-powered mock data generation and live reload for Frappe templates.

### AI
- [Foxmayn AI](https://nascodes.dev/projects/foxmayn-ai): Enterprise RAG platform with multi-strategy retrieval, BullMQ workers, and multi-tenant knowledge base management.
- [Foxmayn AI CLI](https://nascodes.dev/projects/foxmayn-ai-cli): Terminal chat UI for 7 AI models via OpenRouter, built with Go and Bubble Tea.

### Dev Tools
- [ffc — Foxmayn Frappe CLI](https://nascodes.dev/projects/foxmayn-frappe-cli): Go CLI for full Frappe/ERPNext site management — CRUD, schema inspection, reports, and RPC from the terminal.
- [ffm — Foxmayn Frappe Manager](https://nascodes.dev/projects/foxmayn-frappe-manager): Single-command Frappe bench creation with Docker orchestration, smart port allocation, and Traefik domain routing.

## Portfolio Tech Stack

This portfolio is built with:
- **Framework**: Next.js 16.1.1 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript 5.9
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 4
- **UI**: Radix UI / shadcn/ui
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **Content**: MDX (next-mdx-remote)
- **AI Integration**: OpenRouter, LangChain, Qdrant
- **i18n**: next-intl (English/French)
